subject: Rapid ramp — 20min walkthrough to validate performance for BrightBridge

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Rapid ramp — 20min walkthrough to validate performance for BrightBridge

Hi Asha,

Congrats on the usage uptick this week — I noticed BrightBridge crossed the 150k token threshold in the last 48 hours and wanted to offer a quick 20-minute session to walk through a few performance and cost levers that could reduce token spend while keeping latency consistent.

Suggested agenda (short):
- Quick look at what’s driving the token surge (prefixes, batch settings)
- 2 config tweaks we typically recommend for analytics-heavy workloads
- Next steps & milestones (if useful, pass to your infra/ops)

I’m available today 11:00–12:00 PT or 3:00–4:30 PT, and tomorrow morning 8:30–10:00 PT. If none of those work, tell me what does and I’ll coordinate. Attaching a one-page agenda and a usage snapshot for context.

Thanks — happy to keep this short and tactical.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
redwood.ai

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the heads up and for pulling the usage snapshot. Yes, we saw a burst during an overnight batch and want to make sure it isn’t a configuration issue. 20 minutes sounds perfect.

I can do today at 3:15 PM PT but I’ll need to push it to 3:30 if an engineer is still in a stand-up. Can you do 3:30–3:50 PT? Also, please include the AE if there are contractual questions.

Best,
